title: Fast computation of Riemann-Roch spaces for singular curves
summary: Let C be a projective curve defined over a field k and let D be a divisor of C. The Riemann-Roch space L(D) is the set of rational functions on C for which certain zeros are imposed and certain poles are allowed, with some multiplicities determined by D. Riemann-Roch spaces play a fundamental role in algebraic geometry due to the central place of the Riemann-Roch theorem. They have also important applications, such as coding theory or arithmetic of Jacobians of curves. In this article, we present what we believe is the fastest algorithm to date that computes a basis of a Riemann-Roch space…
